pattern.crimePattern: student selling leaked exams kills the lecturer about to report him by making a lab oven live
pattern.notes: Fictional college. The electrical method is described only at the level of "an earth wire was cut and a live wire touched the case"; no instructions, tools list or wiring detail beyond what the deduction needs.

ob.text: Njoro Agricultural College reports that a lecturer, Dr. Damaris Wanjohi (44), was found dead in the soil-science laboratory at about 16:30, beside a soil-drying oven she had just opened. Recorded as a suspected electrical accident.

people.name: Dr. Damaris Wanjohi
people.bio: Opens the same soil-drying oven at half past four every day. As exams officer, she sees every leak complaint.

facts.text: Dr. Damaris Wanjohi was found dead in the soil lab at about 16:30, beside a drying oven she had just opened. Recorded as an electrical accident.
The oven's back-panel screws have been loosened.
Joshua: the oven's earth wire has been freshly cut: bright copper ends, no corrosion. "Old wiring doesn't cut itself."
Joshua: the live wire's insulation was stripped with a tool and bent to touch the metal case. "Someone made this oven live."
Joshua: the lab's safety cut-out switch (RCD) has been removed from the board, "months ago, by the dust".
The two cut ends of the oven's earth wire, bagged for comparison.
Safety checklist: every Friday ticked "earth OK, RCD OK" through to today, all in the same pen and pressure, as if filled in at one sitting.
On her phone, a student's screenshot: group "Njoro Leaks": "CAT papers KSh 500, send to 07xx xxx 562".
Her draft email to the disciplinary committee, saved Monday, names Ronald Omwenga. The meeting was set for Thursday.
Library turnstile: 'R. Omwenga — in 14:02, out 15:40, in 17:10.'
Robotics club register: toolkit #7, including side-cutters, issued to R. Omwenga this term.
Club contact list: R. Omwenga, 07xx xxx 562.
Club patron: J. Ndolo, the electrician. Dr. Wanjohi has no role in the robotics club.
Canteen receipt: E. Kiprop, tea, 15:45. The canteen lady says he stayed until about 16:20.
Brenda: at about 15:50 Ronald went into the soil lab "with his robotics bag", and came out about ten minutes later.
Brenda went into her practical class at 16:00 and stayed until 18:00; it is on the class register.
Side-cutters from toolkit #7, in Ronald's room: a small notch in one jaw.
Senate attendance: Dr. K. Mugambi present 15:00–17:30.
Ronald's transcript: a B+ average. He has failed nothing.
Noticeboard: last week's moderation meeting. Someone has scribbled: "Dr. M. walked out."
Nelly: she was at the library desk all afternoon. The turnstiles never lie, "but students try."
Autopsy: electrocution. Entry burn on the right palm, exit on the left foot.
Autopsy: death at about 16:30.
Autopsy: no other injury. No blow, no sign of a heart attack.
Lab: the cut wire ends carry the impression of a notched jaw. They match the side-cutters from toolkit #7.
Toxicology: clean. No chemicals, no drugs.
Ronald: "I was in the library from two until six."
Ronald: "I've never touched those ovens."
Ronald admits he went to the soil lab at about 15:50 "to ask her for a chance". He says she wasn't there and he left.
Elkanah: "I checked that oven this morning. It was earthed. The RCD was working."
Elkanah admits he took the RCD out in June because it kept tripping, and ticked the checklist every Friday without checking. Anyone who used the lab often knew.
Dr. Mugambi: "I was in senate all afternoon."
Dr. Mugambi: the moderation quarrel was professional. "She was usually right. I walked out because she was right."

interrogations.intro: Ronald sits with his backpack on his knees. "Dr. Wanjohi? That's terrible. I was in the library."

topics.reply: Anyone can make a WhatsApp group. Anyone can type a number.
Kit seven is mine this term. Lots of people borrow things from it.

interrogations.intro: Elkanah keeps clicking his pen. "I check the ovens every Friday. Every Friday."

topics.reply: That oven is old. They're all old. I asked for new ones three years running.

interrogations.intro: Dr. Mugambi doesn't sit down. "I hope you are not here because I disagreed with a colleague about marks."

topics.reply: It was professional. She was usually right. I walked out because she was right.

interrogations.intro: Nelly turns her screen so Amani can see the swipes. "The turnstiles never lie. Students try."

topics.reply: Omwenga? He swiped out at twenty to four. I remember because he usually stays until we close.

interrogations.intro: Brenda is still holding her practical notes. "I was waiting for my practical. I saw him go in."

topics.reply: The robotics boy. He had his robotics bag. He went into the soil lab and came out maybe ten minutes later. He didn't look at me.

interrogations.intro: Joshua takes the torch out of his teeth. "Thirty years I keep these buildings lit. This was done. It didn't happen."

topics.reply: That RCD would have saved her. It was taken out months ago. Look at the dust.

contradictions.reaction: I went to the lab. To ask her to give me a chance. She wasn't there. I left. That's all.
He looks at the photograph of the notched jaw for a long time. "I want my father here."
The RCD kept tripping. I took it out in June so the ovens would run. I filled the checklist every Friday without checking. I have been afraid every day since June.

words.text: electrocuted by an oven he deliberately made live
an accident caused by old, faulty wiring
she was about to report him for selling leaked exam papers

prosecutor.pass: He left the library, was seen going in with his bag, and his side-cutters cut that wire. Charge the boy.
fail: Doesn't hold up. The technician lied about a switch, not a wire. Who was in that lab at ten to four?
No. Sort your liars: one hid negligence, one hid a killing.

prosecutor.pass: A cut earth, a live wire bent to the case, and no switch to save her. Deliberate. Yes.
fail: Old wiring doesn't cut itself. Ask the electrician.
The pathologist found electrical burns. Read them.

prosecutor.pass: Expulsion and a criminal report on Thursday. That's the reason. And send the college a letter about that switch.
fail: He has a B+ average. That isn't it.
That quarrel belongs to a man who was in senate. Read her phone.

timeOfDeath.note: The act window: the oven was made live while the technician was at tea. She touched it at 16:30.

proof.concludes: This was no accident of old wiring: the earth wire was freshly cut and the live wire deliberately bent to the case. Nothing tripped because the technician had removed the safety switch in June and faked the checklist.
Ronald said he was in the library until six, but he swiped out at 15:40, and Brenda saw him go into the lab with his robotics bag at 15:50, while the technician was at tea. He admits going in.

His club side-cutters cut the wire. The leaks group's number is his, and Damaris was reporting him on Thursday. Ronald Omwenga killed her by making the oven live, because she was about to report him for selling leaked exams.

eliminations.why: Elkanah was at tea in the canteen from 15:45 to 16:20. His lie hid negligence, not murder.
Dr. Mugambi was in senate from 15:00 to 17:30.
Nelly was at the library desk all afternoon.
Brenda was outside the lab, then in her practical class from 16:00.
The earth wire was freshly cut by a tool, not worn through.
He has a B+ average and has failed nothing.
The faked checks are Elkanah's failing, not a reason to kill.
That quarrel was Dr. Mugambi's, and he was in senate.
Dr. Wanjohi had no role in the robotics club.

reconstruction.text: A student sends Damaris a screenshot: a WhatsApp group selling leaked papers, KSh 500 each, to one number. On Monday she tells Ronald the committee meets on Thursday.
He knows two things from the robotics club: how the lab's old ovens are wired, and that the technician took out the safety switch months ago.
15:40. He swipes out of the library. 15:50. With the technician at tea, he goes into the soil lab with his robotics bag. Brenda sees him.
He opens the back panel of her oven, cuts the earth wire with his club side-cutters, and bends the live wire to the case. Ten minutes.
16:30. Dr. Wanjohi opens her oven, as she does every day.

clockPlan.note: No detention needed. The warrant on the hostel room needs Brenda's sighting; tool marks take 8 h.

ui.beatNotes: Two liars where only one is the killer. The notebook's red and grey marks (from case 14) now do real work: the player sorts which broken claim implicates and which only embarrasses.
